corporate_announcements.summary: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Joint Venture Agreement executed between Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, Dixon Electroconnect Private Limited and Gemtek Technology Co., Ltd
corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited 7th October, 2026 To To Secretary Secretary Listing Department Listing Department BSE Limited National Stock Exchange of India Limited Department of Corporate Services Exchange Plaza, Bandra Kurla Complex Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, Mumbai – 400 051 Dalal Street, Mumbai – 400 001 Scrip Code – 540699 Scrip Code - DIXON ISIN: INE935N01020 ISIN: INE935N01020 Dear Sir/Madam, Subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and in continuation of our earlier intimation dated June 9, 2026. This is in continuation of our earlier intimation dated June 9, 2026, whereby Dixon Technologies (India) Limited (“Company”) informed the stock exchanges that the Company, Gemtek Technology Co., Ltd. (“Gemtek”), and Dixon Electroconnect Private Limited (“Dixon Electroconnect”), wholly owned subsidiary of the Company as on the date, proposed joint venture company (collectively the “Parties”), had entered into a binding term sheet on June 9, 2026 in relation to the proposed joint venture arrangement. Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI LODR Regulations”), we hereby inform you that, the Parties have executed a joint venture agreement on 7th October, 2026 (“JV Agreement”) pursuant to which Dixon Electroconnect will carry on the business of manufacturing and supply of Optical Transceiver - SFP (Small Form- Factor Pluggable) and BOSA (Bidirectional Optical Subassembly) or other telecom products as may be mutually agreed by the Parties from time to time in India. The transactions contemplated under the JV Agreement remain subject to completion of customary conditions precedent (“Proposed Transaction”). Upon completion of the Proposed Transaction, the share capital of Dixon Electroconnect will be held by the Company and Gemtek in the proportion of 60% and 40%, respectively. Pursuant to Proposed Transaction, neither the Company nor Gemtek will acquire any stake in each other. The disclosures prescribed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations and SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026 are enclosed as Annexure A. We request you to kindly take this on your record and oblige. Thanking you For Dixon Technologies (India) Limited Ashish Kumar President - Chief Legal Counsel & Group CS Encl: As Above Regd.
